phrases.def: 印加文明 西班牙语之前的

sentences.en: An explorer's encounter with the ruined city of Machu Picchu, the most famous icon of the Inca civilisation
sentences.zh: 一位探险家与印加文明最著名的标志马丘比丘废墟的邂逅

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A. When the US explorer and academic Hiram Bingham arrived in South America in 1911, he was ready for what was to be the greatest achievement of his life: the exploration of the remote hinterland to the west of Cusco, the old capital of the Inca empire in the Andes mountains of Peru.
sentences.zh: A. 当美国探险家兼学者海勒姆·宾厄姆 (Hiram Bingham) 于 1911 年抵达南美洲时,他已准备好迎接他一生中最伟大的成就：探索位于秘鲁安第斯山脉的印加帝国旧都库斯科以西的偏远腹地。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: His goal was to locate the remains of a city called Vitcos, the last capital of the Inca civilisation.
sentences.zh: 他的目标是找到一座名为维特科斯的城市的遗迹,这是印加文明的最后一个首都。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Cusco lies on a high plateau at an elevation of more than 3,000 metres, and Bingham's plan was to descend from this plateau along the valley of the Urubamba River, which takes a circuitous route down to the Amazon and passes through an area of dramatic canyons and mountain ranges.
sentences.zh: 库斯科位于海拔3000多米的高原上,宾厄姆的计划是从这个高原沿着乌鲁班巴河谷下降,这条河蜿蜒曲折地到达亚马逊河,并穿过一个充满戏剧性峡谷和山脉的地区。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B. When Bingham and his team set off down the Urubamba in late July, they had an advantage over travellers who had preceded them: a track had recently been blasted down the valley canyon to enable rubber to be brought up by mules from the jungle.
sentences.zh: B. 当宾厄姆和他的团队在七月下旬沿着乌鲁班巴出发时,他们比之前的旅行者有一个优势：最近在山谷峡谷中炸毁了一条轨道,以便骡子可以从丛林中运来橡胶。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Almost all previous travellers had left the river at Ollantaytambo and taken a high pass across the mountains to rejoin the river lower down, thereby cutting a substantial corner, but also therefore never passing through the area.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有之前的旅行者都是在奥扬泰坦博离开河流,然后翻越山脉,在下游重新汇入河流,从而绕过了一个很大的拐角,但也因此从未穿过该地区。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: around Machu Picchu.
sentences.zh: 马丘比丘周围。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C. On 24 July they were a few days into their descent of the valley.
sentences.zh: C. 7 月 24 日,他们下山谷几天了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The day began slowly, with Bingham trying to arrange sufficient mules for the next stage of the trek.
sentences.zh: 这一天开始得很慢,宾厄姆试图为下一阶段的徒步旅行安排足够的骡子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: His companions showed no interest in accompanying him up the nearby hill to see some ruins that a local farmer, Melchor Arteaga, had told them about the night before.
sentences.zh: 他的同伴没有兴趣陪他上附近的山去参观当地农民 Melchor Arteaga 前一天晚上告诉他们的一些废墟。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The morning was dull and damp, and Bingham also seems to have been less than keen on the prospect of climbing the hill.
sentences.zh: 早晨阴沉潮湿,宾厄姆似乎也不太热衷于爬山。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In his book Lost City of the Incas, he relates that he made the ascent without having the least expectation that he would find anything at the top.
sentences.zh: 在他的《印加失落之城》一书中,他讲述了他在登顶时并没有想到会在山顶找到任何东西。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: D. Bingham writes about the approach in vivid style in his book.
sentences.zh: D. Bingham 在他的书中以生动的风格描述了这种方法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: First, as he climbs up the hill, he describes the ever-present possibility of deadly snakes, 'capable of making considerable springs when in pursuit of their prey'; not that he sees any.
sentences.zh: 首先,当他爬上山时,他描述了致命蛇永远存在的可能性,“在追捕猎物时能够做出相当大的跳跃”；他并没有看到任何东西。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Then there's a sense of mounting discovery as he comes across great sweeps of terraces, then a mausoleum, followed by monumental staircases and, finally, the grand ceremonial buildings of Machu Picchu.
sentences.zh: 然后,当他看到大片的梯田,然后是一座陵墓,然后是巨大的楼梯,最后是马丘比丘的宏伟仪式建筑时,他有一种不断发现的感觉。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: 'It seemed like an unbelievable dream... the sight held me spellbound...' he wrote.
sentences.zh: “这似乎是一个令人难以置信的梦......这一景象让我着迷......”他写道。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: E. We should remember, however, that Lost City of the Incas is a work of hindsight, not written until 1948, many years after his journey.
sentences.zh: E. 然而,我们应该记住,《印加失落之城》是一部事后诸葛亮的作品,直到 1948 年才写成,也就是他的旅程多年之后。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: His journal entries of the time reveal a much more gradual appreciation of his achievement.
sentences.zh: 他当时的日记显示了他对自己成就的更加渐进的欣赏。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: He spent the afternoon at the ruins noting down the dimensions of some of the buildings, then descended and rejoined his companions, to whom he seems to have said little about his discovery.
sentences.zh: 他在废墟上度过了一个下午,记下一些建筑物的尺寸,然后下降并与他的同伴会合,他似乎很少对他们谈论他的发现。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: At this stage, Bingham didn't realise the extent or the importance of the site, nor did he realise what use he could make of the discovery.
sentences.zh: 在这个阶段,宾汉姆没有意识到该地点的范围或重要性,也没有意识到他可以利用这一发现做什么。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: F. However, soon after returning it occurred to him that he could make a name for himself from this discovery.
sentences.zh: F. 然而,回来后不久,他突然想到,他可以通过这一发现而出名。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: When he came to write the National Geographic magazine article that broke the story to the world in April 1913, he knew he had to produce a big idea.
sentences.zh: 1913 年 4 月,当他开始撰写《国家地理》杂志的文章,向全世界揭露这个故事时,他知道自己必须想出一个伟大的想法。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: He wondered whether it could have been the birthplace of the very first Inca, Manco the Great, and whether it could also have been what chroniclers described as the last city of the Incas'.
sentences.zh: 他想知道它是否可能是第一位印加人曼科大帝的出生地,以及是否也可能是编年史家所描述的印加人最后的城市。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This term refers to Vilcabamba the settlement where the Incas had fled from Spanish invaders in the 1530s.
sentences.zh: 该术语指的是比尔卡班巴 (Vilcabamba),印加人在 1530 年代逃离西班牙入侵者的定居点。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Bingham made desperate attempts to prove this belief for nearly 40 years.
sentences.zh: 近 40 年来,宾厄姆一直在拼命尝试证明这一信念。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sadly, his vision of the site as both the beginning and end of the Inca civilisation, while a magnificent one, is inaccurate.
sentences.zh: 可悲的是,他将该遗址视为印加文明的起点和终点的愿景虽然宏伟,但并不准确。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: We now know that Vilcabamba actually lies 65 kilometres away in the depths of the jungle.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道比尔卡班巴实际上位于 65 公里外的丛林深处。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: G. One question that has perplexed visitors, historians and archaeologists alike ever since Bingham, is why the site seems to have been abandoned before the Spanish Conquest.
sentences.zh: G. 自宾厄姆以来一直困扰着游客、历史学家和考古学家的一个问题是,为什么该遗址似乎在西班牙征服之前就被遗弃了。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: There are no references to it by any of the Spanish chroniclers - and if they had known of its existence so close to Cusco they would certainly have come in search of gold.
sentences.zh: 任何西班牙编年史家都没有提到过它 - 如果他们知道它的存在离库斯科如此之近,他们肯定会来寻找黄金。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: An idea which has gained wide acceptance over the past few years is that Machu Picchu was a moya, a country estate built by an Inca emperor to escape the cold winters of Cusco, where the elite could enjoy monumental architecture and spectacular views.
sentences.zh: 过去几年得到广泛接受的一个想法是,马丘比丘是莫亚,是印加皇帝为了躲避库斯科寒冷的冬天而建造的乡村庄园,精英们可以在那里欣赏宏伟的建筑和壮丽的景色。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the particular architecture of Machu Picchu suggests that it was constructed at the time of the greatest of all the Incas, the emperor Pachacuti (c. 1438-71).
sentences.zh: 此外,马丘比丘的特殊建筑表明它是在印加最伟大的皇帝帕查库蒂（c. 1438-71）时代建造的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: By custom, Pachacuti's descendants built other similar estates for their own use, and so Machu Picchu would have been abandoned after his death, some 50 years before the Spanish Conquest.
sentences.zh: 按照惯例,帕查库蒂的后代建造了其他类似的庄园供自己使用,因此马丘比丘在他死后（即西班牙征服之前约 50 年）就被遗弃了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

instructions: Questions 14-20: Reading Passage 2 has seven paragraphs, A-G. Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below.
Questions 21-24: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 2?

items.prompt: Bingham went to South America in search of an Inca city.
Bingham chose a particular route down the Urubamba valley because it was the most common route used by travellers.
Bingham understood the significance of Machu Picchu as soon as he saw it.
Bingham returned to Machu Picchu in order to find evidence to support his theory
The track that took Bingham down the Urubamba valley had been created for the transportation of …
Bingham found out about the ruins of Machu Picchu from a…in the Urubamba valley.
